high_level_description: The image is a news headline from the Deccan Herald, a newspaper. The headline reads: "Surgical births surge in Bengaluru, 44% of all deliveries are C-sections." This indicates a significant increase in the number of surgical births (C-sections) in Bengaluru, with the percentage of such deliveries reaching 44%. The accompanying image shows a close-up of a hand wearing a white glove, holding an ultrasound probe. The ultrasound probe is being used on a person's abdomen, suggesting that the image is related to medical procedures, specifically prenatal care or delivery.
